description: This Java source file implements a logging facade for Logback, providing methods to set log levels and retrieve logger configurations within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: LogbackLoggingFacade
classes.description: A final class implementing the LoggingFacade interface for Logback, providing methods to configure and retrieve logger settings.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of LogbackLoggingFacade.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level for a specified logger based on the provided LoggerConfig.

methods.name: getLoggerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current logger configurations for all loggers.

methods.name: getLoggerConfig (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves logger configurations for a given set of logger names.

methods.name: loggerConfigsFor
methods.description: Helper method to generate a list of LoggerConfig objects from an iterable of Logback Logger instances.
